2026-10-31T10-19-57_dunbar-s-number-why-.caption:

• Your brain only has enough capacity for about 150 real relationships.
• Pushing past this limit destroys natural trust and accountability.
• Big teams accidentally replace human connection with heavy bureaucracy.
• Smart leaders keep core working pods small and autonomous.

How do you keep large teams feeling close-knit?

2026-10-31T14-51-59_the-red-queen-effect.caption:
Why working harder sometimes gets you absolutely nowhere. 

• The Red Queen Effect traps us in endless races.
• Individual hustle raises the baseline for everyone.
• Working twice as hard often keeps you in the exact same spot.
• True progress comes from changing the game, not running faster.

Are you running a race you forgot how you entered?

• They drop a chemical scent trail on the way back.

• Weather is a complex system of sensitive triggers.
• Tiny rounding errors double and triple rapidly.
• Small starting differences create wildly different endings.
• This math trap applies to stocks, traffic, and habits.
